resolution_policy.historical_authority: The pinned pre-freeze tree/entries and exact controlled hashes are historical, never redefined from successor HEAD.
resolution_policy.tag: Resolve this named annotated tag and require its raw commit parent/subject plus manifest, protected blobs and annotation.
resolution_policy.object: Explicit final freeze object uses raw commit headers; shallow traversal must not infer parents.
resolution_policy.manifest_only: Authenticate the manifest SHA from the freeze register and reconstruct its exact historical Git tree without requiring absent historical refs. Never silently substitute successor HEAD for the frozen object.
resolution_policy.candidate: Compare exact candidate tree to the pre-freeze inventory with only the eleven named governance paths permitted. All other files, modes and deletions remain protected.
resolution_policy.post_commit_evidence: Completion report records actual final commit/count, isolated QA, hosted job URLs and tag object/peeled commit without circular self-hash or amendment.
